title: Sleeping Snorlax
description: Poke a peacefully sleeping Snorlax to trigger escalating procedural reactions, combos, wake-ups, and permanent growth.

prompt.objective: Build a 3D creature-poking toy where repeated interaction escalates reactions and growth.

mintAssets.brief: A friendly oversized round sleeping creature with a soft belly.
Meadow ambience, deep snoring, a bubble pop, and a padded impact.

experience: Poke the creature to score combos and trigger varied procedural fidgets.
Let rapid pokes wake the sleeper and make each wake-up increase its size.
prompt.visualDirection: Sunny low-poly meadow, pastel materials, bold UI, and elastic motion.

thumbnail.alt: A large sleeping Snorlax resting in a sunny low-poly meadow beneath a Poke Snorlax prompt.
